SCL Mellon offers a collaborative environment where professionals can work closely with diverse clients and contribute to innovative digital initiatives. We are looking for a professional who can understand the strategic thinking behind a digital campaign, and at the same time see opportunities beyond owned channels — through media, creators, partnerships and earned visibility. Support PR initiatives, media outreach and earned visibility opportunities. Coordinate influencer and creator collaborations, from research and outreach to briefing, execution and reporting. Support launches, events, partnerships and brand activations. Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget and to a high standard. Monitor digital, media and cultural trends and turn them into relevant opportunities for clients. Qualifications 3+ years of experience in account management, digital marketing, PR or communications, preferably within an agency environment. Strong understanding of the digital and social media ecosystem. Previous experience in PR, media relations, influencer marketing or creator collaborations. Strong client management and communication skills. Ability to think strategically and challenge a brief rather than simply execute it. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously. Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Greek and English. Confidence working in a fast-paced agency environment with high standards. Curiosity about brands, culture, media, creators and emerging communication trends. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across different disciplines. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; prior agency experience is an asset. What we offer Gross monthly salary starting from €1,800, depending on experience and profile. Annual performance bonus equivalent to one additional monthly salary. Hybrid working option after the first 6 months, with up to 2 remote-working days per week. Remote working option on the first day of menstruation, when needed. Continuous learning and access to resources for professional and personal development. Birthday leave. Inspiring and challenging projects across different industries and brands. A dynamic, independent agency environment with room to grow, take ownership and make an impact. If you are up for it, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV to hello@socialmellon.com.
